##### Project general facts

Saddlewood Park, developed by MAK Developers, presents a low-rise residential project in Nad Al Sheba 1, near the Meydan Racecourse. The architectural design draws inspiration from equestrian aesthetics, blending classic forms with modern elements. The project features a distinctive golden gradient detail and a warm, calming color scheme, aiming for timeless sophistication.

Amenities encompass a range of offerings focused on wellness and recreation, including an AI-powered gym, a rooftop infinity pool, a floating cinema, zen gardens, steam and sauna rooms, and yoga decks. A clubhouse is also provided, designed to enhance the resident experience through thoughtful design and modern conveniences.

Interiors showcase modern finishing with warm woods, veined stone, brushed gold, and soft textures throughout. Kitchens are equipped with appliances from Miele, Villeroy & Boch, and Gessi, and a Smart Home System from Systeme Electric is integrated into each residence. The residences are delivered delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba 1 is one of Dubai’s most prestigious and centrally located residential neighborhoods, renowned for its serene ambiance and proximity to the iconic Meydan Racecourse. This area seamlessly blends suburban tranquility with city connectivity, offering residents quick access to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. The neighborhood’s spacious layout and landscaped surroundings contribute to a refined and exclusive living environment.

The district is known for its elegant villas, upscale residential projects, and proximity to the future-forward Meydan City masterplan, making it an ideal destination for families and investors alike. Nad Al Sheba 1 also enjoys a low-density urban character, offering privacy and space while being within minutes of some of Dubai’s most dynamic leisure and commercial zones.

Residents benefit from a wealth of nearby amenities, including elite schools, healthcare centers, sports complexes, and high-end retail at Meydan One Mall (in development). Whether enjoying a morning jog along tree-lined streets or watching equestrian events at the world-famous racecourse, Nad Al Sheba 1 offers a lifestyle that is both sophisticated and deeply connected to Dubai’s rich cultural and sporting heritage.
